composition_variation: Create a polished editorial anime portrait of adult Kento Nanami outside a small bakery on a peaceful morning. Preserve his neatly side-parted blond hair, angular face, understated glasses, and composed expression. He wears a beige suit over a pale blue shirt with a loosely arranged patterned tie. He holds a folded plain paper bread bag at his side and pauses mid-step naturally. Use butter-yellow bakery light, pale stone, muted teal window reflections, warm pastry colors, and a clean cream upper facade. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
